description: Validate one ZUGFeRD or Factur-X PDF. The file is uploaded to POST https://checkxrechnung.com/v1/zugferd/validate. Checks PDF/A-3 basics (veraPDF when installed, otherwise a labelled structure check), extracts factur-x.xml, zugferd-invoice.xml or xrechnung.xml, detects the profile (MINIMUM, BASIC WL, BASIC, EN16931, EXTENDED, XRECHNUNG) and validates the XML with the EN 16931 CII Schematron. Profile XRECHNUNG also runs the XRechnung CII Schematron. Same free limit as validate_xrechnung (shared counter): 50 per IP per UTC day, 10 per minute. PDF limit 10 MB. Returns valid, profile, and errors with rule_id and rule_url.

file_path.description: Path to a ZUGFeRD or Factur-X PDF. Resolved by this process.

name: validate_zugferd
